BiblicalUsage: Former is the word for what lies behind: remember not the former things, neither consider the things of old; the offering shall be pleasant as in the days of old and as in former years; and the northern army shall be driven with his face toward the east sea.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the former things as both warning and promise: God tells His people to forget them and to hope for them at the same time.
